hypothesis: A preauthored sparse residual learner that adds a new fourth-order causal feature only when its conditional held-training validation improvement exceeds 3% will improve cold consequence prediction by at least 5% versus the strongest conventional fully fitted learner, 3% versus the exactly matched validation-selected path, on both independent seed cohorts, and without >10% family-specific degradation. Falsify if any critical gate fails.

data.generator: ENERGY-67:v1 from frozen experiment.py, source-keyed NumPy PCG64
data.input: 9 binary controllable do-action bits, NO nuisance variables in this study
data.latent_mechanism: three signed two-input parity factors OLD, coefficient-shifted old factors plus 2 or 4 new fourth-order parity factors NEW, optional fifth-order out-of-grammar factor; iid Gaussian noise sigma .18
data.cold_definition: Held actions disjoint from OLD/NEW/held OLD/held NEW under NEW source mechanism; not an independently new environment or nuisance shift
data.leakage: Predictions of held consequences, planted support indices, and generator coefficients never enter model fit, feature choice, validation or hyperparameter selection; generator truth in original scorer receipts only for independent auditor, audited separately

methods.feature_grammar: researcher-supplied 36 two-bit Walsh terms and 126 fourth-order Walsh terms from 9 known causal bits; optional 5th-order planted effect OUTSIDE this grammar
methods.old: 3-pair greedy OMP-style sparse model from OLD observations; old readout cloned exactly
methods.candidate: NEW greedy fourth-order path with 0 to 5 additions; fit first 48 outcomes, compare 16 NEW validation consequences; accept each sequential factor only when loss decreases at least 3%, stop at first failure; refit selected basis on all 64 NEW
methods.same_compute_primary_control: cv_growth picks k in 0..5 with minimum validation loss from the EXACT SAME candidate path, six ridge fits and split; then refits all 64 NEW
other_controls: fixed_two and fixed_five same greedy path
matched_elasticnet: 5 predetermined alphas .01,.03,.1,.3,1.0; l1=.8 selected by same train/validation; refit on identical OLD supports+all 126 fourth order terms
full_omp_five: full pair+quad grammar with five sparse terms trained NEW
old_support_only Ridge trained on all NEW
shuffled_negative: deterministic source-keyed shuffle of NEW labels, five greedy new terms
methods.fit: Ridge regularization .3 excluding intercept; standard sklearn ElasticNet l1_ratio=.8 tol1e-6 max_iter3000; NumPy greedy projections; no truth-informed control as realistic arm
methods.capacity: Candidate and cv_growth exactly share search path, validation and data; conventional ElasticNet has different capacity/fit cost; no claim equal physical compute across ALL controls
methods.runtime: single core Python 3.13.5, NumPy 2.3.5, SciPy 1.17.0, scikit-learn 1.8.0; environment OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
methods.metrics: Mean world-level OLD/NEW/COLD held MSE; per family and seed cold MSE; adaptive selected feature count and planted factor count; inherited old readout exactness

frozen_screen_gates.vs_strongest_5pct: candidate cold MSE <=0.95*MIN pooled cold MSE across cv_growth,fixed_two,fixed_five,matched_elasticnet,full_omp_five,old_support_only
frozen_screen_gates.both_seed_strongest: candidate mean cold MSE strictly less than minimum conventional control mean in EACH screen seed
frozen_screen_gates.family_non_degradation_10pct: candidate mean cold MSE <=1.10*strongest conventional cold MSE within EACH mechanism family
frozen_screen_gates.adaptive_capacity_response: mean candidate selected fourth-order k in four_quad >= mean selected k in two_quad+1
frozen_screen_gates.old_exact: all 9 arms old-held predictions identical per world (frozen copied old readout)

classifications.SCREEN_PROMISING: All four critical gates and >=8 of 9 gates pass, with independent auditor verified; may then run frozen three-seed 36-world primary on separate seeds; not scientific pass or acceptance
classifications.SCREEN_NO_GO: Any critical gate fails or fewer than 8/9 pass despite valid independent audit. STOP: do not score primary or retune consumed screen seeds
classifications.INVALID: Source or prereg not committed before prospective scoring; wrong dataset/seed counts, fit/held label leakage, missing strongest controls, source drift, independent auditor disagreement, or non-disjoint intervention assignments
classifications.PRIMARY_GO_IF_SCREEN_ELIGIBLE: All nine frozen gates must pass on the three reserved primary seeds with audited outputs and source-identical replay; external development only, never SCIENTIFIC_PASS or native acceptance
classifications.PRIMARY_NO_GO: Any primary frozen gate fails; preserve negative evidence without promotion

isolation: No Yggdrasil main, native learner, weights or accepted reference changes
No deployment, merge, or scientific first use
No rerun of consumed seeds for gate tuning
statement: Exclusion pilot 109701 (3 worlds, audit 12717 checks) was scored before source/prereg freeze. Screening and primary seeds not consumed before this commit. Source and test oracle are contributor-authored. No native tokenless Yggdrasil training is claimed.
